ctx.x: And we thought and we thought, Slim and Slap or something. We were trying to think of a name that was, would be close to the bass fiddle. So it turned up that slamming around at the bass kind of came to us. Maybe if we used the name Slam, Slim and Slam came to us. So that's how it came about, the Slim and the Slam.
